official_recipe.note: Launch-script settings plus defaults from the pinned upstream configuration.

deviations: TRL 1.17.1 instead of the full open-instruct runtime; its launcher initializes new adapters rather than loading our SFT adapter.
Frozen NF4 base plus continued rank-8 SFT adapter instead of full-parameter training.
One preference pair per microbatch, 8-pair effective batch; 2048-token right truncation instead of 16384.
A seeded subset of one pinned shard instead of 150000 pairs.
Peak LR 1e-5 for adapters instead of the full-parameter 8e-8; not tuned.
Frozen copy of our SFT adapter shares the quantized base; reference log probabilities cached before updates.
